Dard Haran Oil is an Ayurvedic oil for joint and muscle massage. Compare 50 ml and 100 ml packs, prices, ingredients and external-use directions.
Questions about Dard Haran Oil
What is Dard Haran Oil used for?
Do the 50 ml and 100 ml oils have the same ingredients?
Yes. Both Dard Haran Oil packs have the same composition; only the pack size differs. Ingredient quantities in the table are stated per 100 ml.
How should I use Dard Haran Oil?
How do Dard Haran Oil and Capsule differ?
Dard Haran Oil is for external massage. Dard Haran Capsule is an oral formulation used under medical supervision. Ask your physician which format is appropriate for you.
